syncComplete.where: Manage > Library: toast after the Drive sync finishes

syncFailed.where: Manage > Library: error toast when the Drive sync fails
syncFailed.context: {reason} is the server's error text (English) or the 'unknown' word

syncFailedUnknown.where: Manage > Library: fills {reason} in the sync-failed toast when no error text is available

syncSubtitle.where: Manage > Library: line under the Library Sync heading
syncSubtitle.context: Google Drive is a product name; the arrow means 'into'. In RTL the arrow can be written ← if it reads better.

syncing.where: Manage > Library: sync button while running

syncDone.where: Manage > Library: green status label after a sync

syncStats.where: Manage > Library: result line after a sync
syncStats.context: {scanned} files scanned in Drive, {added} new charts, {updated} updated charts

syncStatsCopied.where: Manage > Library: appended to the sync result line when files were copied
syncStatsCopied.context: Starts with a space and a middle dot separator; {copied} is a number of files copied to cloud storage

syncCopyErrors.where: Manage > Library: red warning after a sync with copy failures

syncWhatChanged.where: Manage > Library: expandable summary listing newly added files after a sync

songRestored.where: Manage > Library > Archived Songs: toast after Restore

songRestoreFailed.where: Manage > Library > Archived Songs: error toast when Restore fails

statusHealthy.where: Manage > Library > Sync Status card: status when the last Drive sync completed

statusFailed.where: Manage > Library > Sync Status card: status when the last Drive sync failed

statusNoData.where: Manage > Library > Sync Status card: status when no sync has run

syncStatusTitle.where: Manage > Library: card heading for the Drive sync health

lastSync.context: {when} is a relative time already in the user's language, e.g. '3 days ago'

statScanned.where: Manage > Library > Sync Status card: files scanned in the last sync

statAdded.where: Manage > Library > Sync Status card: charts added in the last sync

statUpdated.where: Manage > Library > Sync Status card: charts updated in the last sync

statCopyErrors.where: Manage > Library > Sync Status card: files that failed to copy (red)

filesInLibrary.where: Manage > Library > Sync Status card: follows a bold number (the number is a separate element before this text)
filesInLibrary.context: Always plural in English; the number appears just before it

archivedTitle.where: Manage > Library: heading of the collapsible list of archived charts

archivedEmpty.where: Manage > Library > Archived Songs: empty state

archivedAgo.where: Manage > Library > Archived Songs: line under each archived chart's title
archivedAgo.context: {when} is a relative time already in the user's language, e.g. '2 weeks ago'

restore.where: Manage > Library > Archived Songs: button that un-archives a chart
